case_definition.statement: DEVELOPMENT EXAMPLE (not a scientific case). A depot holds exactly 17 sealed crates. During one transfer window, 12 crates are moved out of the depot to a platform and no crates enter the depot. Nothing else changes the number of crates in the depot.
case_definition.objective: Compute the number of crates remaining in the depot.

input.prompt: A depot holds exactly 17 sealed crates. During one transfer window, 12 crates are moved out of the depot to a platform and no crates enter the depot. Nothing else changes the number of crates in the depot. How many crates remain in the depot? Answer with the integer only.

constraints: Reason from the given premises only.
No external lookup or tool use.

success_criterion: The answer equals the unique value derivable from the premises (committed in the protected ground truth).

verification_rule.description: Integer equality against the sealed expected answer.

ground_truth_reference.seal_holder: format example: values are public dummies (examples/ground-truth.format-example.json)

authoring_provenance.authoring_environment: authored inside the repository foundation solely to illustrate the public case format

structural_signature: single-step integer subtraction over stated premises
